suites.name: Hidden Variable and Residual Failure Audit
Hidden Variable Scaling and Selector Validation

supportedClaims: Compression-Room P1/P1b is the primary transferable High-basin entry pathway.
projHiVec > -0.3281 is a validated residual selector.
projHiVec improves holdout persistence at N=71 (+12.5%) and N=72 (+8.1%).
N=75 is the strongest pathway window.
N=80 is a saturated regime where universal protocols suffice.
The final model must be N-conditioned.
conditionalClaims: P2 Crypto-Hi is demoted to exploratory/local — does not robustly transfer.
projHiVec selector is neutral at N=75.
Lambda1 does not add value beyond projHiVec.
